name: betterinsta
description: Unofficial Firefox extension that adds a quick search button to Instagram on the web.

scripts.lint: web-ext lint --source-dir . --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json README.md PRIVACY.md LICENSE docs/**
scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir . --overwrite-dest --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json README.md PRIVACY.md LICENSE .gitignore docs/**
